name: express-db-access-performance-experiments
description: Benchmark harness comparing relational database access layers (native driver, query builder, ORMs) in Express.js on PostgreSQL and MySQL

scripts.migrate: npm run migrate:pg && npm run migrate:mysql
scripts.seed: npm run seed:pg && npm run seed:mysql
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && sleep 8 && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.bench:quick: ADAPTERS=pg,knex,drizzle,prisma ENGINES=postgres DURATION=3 REPEATS=1 node bench/runner.mjs
scripts.verify:campaign-state: ENGINE=postgres node bench/verify-campaign-state.mjs && ENGINE=mysql node bench/verify-campaign-state.mjs
scripts.verify:fixed: npm run prisma:generate:pg && ENGINE=postgres node bench/verify.mjs && npm run prisma:generate:mysql && ENGINE=mysql node bench/verify.mjs
scripts.verify:spec: npm run prisma:generate:pg && ENGINE=postgres node bench/verify-spec.mjs && npm run prisma:generate:mysql && ENGINE=mysql node bench/verify-spec.mjs
scripts.verify:writes: npm run prisma:generate:pg && ENGINE=postgres node bench/verify-writes.mjs && npm run prisma:generate:mysql && ENGINE=mysql node bench/verify-writes.mjs
scripts.verify:property: npm run prisma:generate:pg && ENGINE=postgres node bench/verify-property.mjs && npm run prisma:generate:mysql && ENGINE=mysql node bench/verify-property.mjs
scripts.tables:primary: RAW_FILE=current-primary.json node scripts/ci-tables.mjs && RAW_FILE=current-primary.json node scripts/gen-analysis-tables.mjs && RAW_FILE=current-primary.json node scripts/gen-p99-significance.mjs && RAW_FILE=current-primary.json node scripts/gen-native-contrasts.mjs && node scripts/gen-rq2-insert-figure.mjs && npm run sync:tables
scripts.tables:current: npm run tables:primary && RAW_FILE=current-primary.json RELAXED_FILE=raw-writes-relaxed-corrected.json node scripts/gen-tables.mjs && npm run sync:tables
